request:
镜头 s34：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，昏暗，只有手电光。停电的小公寓里，宋念从铁皮箱里取出那本旧笔记本，翻开封面，灰尘在手电光里飘。环境声：手电开关声、翻纸声、远处的警报。
情绪：hushed, intimate, expectant
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium close-up, handheld with a slight sway
景深与虚实：Flashlight pool sharp, everything outside it in noisy darkness.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité in Nian's cramped apartment during the blackout: she kneels by the bunk with a flashlight and lifts a worn hardback notebook out of an old metal box; dust floats in the flashlight beam. Blocking lock: Nian kneels at frame left by the bunk, the metal box and the notebook at frame centre in the flashlight beam; darkness around.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: Nian's cramped apartment in the underground city (location reference; role: location reference). A cramped family apartment in an underground city: steel walls, a narrow bunk bed, a small wall screen glowing blue, a round porthole window looking out on the lit shaft of the city, a folding table with a teapot and a worn notebook. Empty of people, dim.
Picture 4: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：flashlight click, paper rustle, a distant alarm
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/light-flashlight] 现场光：手电与停电
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/light/flashlight-beam] light
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium close-up, shoulder-mounted handheld camera with one slight sway and a small late reframe, opening on the metal box and the notebook at frame centre and settling a little toward Nian at frame left. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start Nian kneels at frame left beside the narrow bunk, her right hand holding a small flashlight whose hard pool sits on the metal box at frame centre, the notebook lying inside it; frame right is empty dark air, the blue-glow wall screen and the porthole behind her in the background. Start: her hand comes into the beam, thumb clicking the flashlight once to steady the light, the noise of the switch sharp in the still room. Middle: she sets the torch down angled on the pillow so the beam keeps its pool, then lifts the worn hardback notebook out of the box with both hands, slowly, and the dust that was resting on it lifts and drifts in the light, turning over and over. End: she turns the cover open with her thumb, the yellowed tape and the crayon drawing catching the beam, and she holds still, shoulders dropped, breathing shallow, eyes moving across the page; the notebook stays open in her hands at frame centre. Mood: hushed, intimate, expectant. Blur: the notebook and her hands inside the flashlight pool are sharp, the moving dust motes drift in and out of focus, her face sits at the soft edge of the beam and the rest of the room dissolves into grainy darkness, the wall-screen glow a shapeless blue patch behind her; focus occasionally hunts and recovers. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.
